title: Russian Potato Gratin
description: A creamy, rich side dish topped with a crispy crust. Perfect for cold winter nights.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced potatoes and grated onion.
In a separate bowl, mix together milk, grated gratin, and minced garlic.
Add the milk mixture to the potato mixture and toss until coated.
Transfer the potato mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
